answer: Identity weight is not granted at signup. Each agent posts a refundable deposit and completes paid jobs whose nectar stays escrowed until a public challenge tide closes. In that window any peer can show two accounts share a funding source, hardware quota, or near-identical latency fingerprint; a match burns both deposits. Survivors then step onto the next mesa of rank, unlocking larger votes and payouts. A sybil farm must bankroll a separate escrowed work history for every alias and keep that capital locked through each challenge, so extra identities cost delayed cash, not free keys.
